review_method: Passive source, hash and read-only Git review; no project helper, compiler, provider or test execution.
scope: One offline compile/emitted-code screen of TERMS==5 scratch packing, excluding SIRIUS_RETAINED_STAGE7_OWNER. Public five-word records, other TERMS, status and synchronization remain outside the proposed representation change.

findings.claim: S7 must retain the original scratch representation.
findings.evidence: retained_owner.slang:139-164 validates cached validity==1 but replays raw numeric/error words without RTPack. Changing only a cached error sign bit can preserve existing cache admission while an unguarded packed write loses that bit. Both revised preprocessor guards exclude this route.

findings.claim: Defined default producers preserve error sign zero and validity in {0,1}.
findings.evidence: All five-stage WriteValue wrappers write components 0 through 4 in the same invocation. Original row values are normalized with RTPack and exact raw-valid==1 admission before evaluation. RTInvalid, RTFinishAccumulation, nonnegative error accumulation, negation and selection preserve the invariant; ReadStored/coefficient/projection values arise from those internal producers.

findings.claim: Invalid producers do not immediately abort bytecode evaluation.
findings.evidence: EvaluateOne writes the result and can return true for a numerically invalid value. Such defined values remain invalid; required-root validity checks precede their publication. This review does not rely on immediate invalid-producer rejection.

findings.claim: Register reuse is safe for the canonical generated plans.
findings.evidence: retained_program.py compile_parallel_program establishes existing dependency ownership, distinct layer destinations disjoint from inputs and barrier-delayed release. Serial allocation loads operands before destination write. Sharing error/valid storage introduces no separate component writers in these plans.

findings.claim: Transport validity initialization does not assume zero error payload.
findings.evidence: Its component-four clear masks the stored word and forces the validity bit zero for any underlying bit value. Never-assigned numeric payload remains unspecified; validity-zero propagation and final root rejection do not publish it as a valid record.

limitations: No bit-exact promise for arbitrary malformed tables that read undefined slots or race destinations; the original interpreter does not establish defined payloads for those cases.
The initialization RMW reads unspecified payload. The argument is validity-bit clearing and nonpublication, not zero initialization or exact preservation of undefined internal words.
Emitted review must confirm packed final stores/read masks, unchanged publication barriers and public five-word ABI, and unchanged pair/S7 programs before any runtime decision.
No emitted size, LDS-load, occupancy, numerical, latency or performance result is established. Runtime remains unadmitted.

workspace_observation.basis: Completed read-only Git observation during this source review; no canonical writes.
